_readme: The client wall on About (07-about.md §5). AUTHORED, not derived: 28 of the 32 rows
have no record behind them, so there is nothing in projects.json to derive them from.
`file` names images/logos/<file>.webp. `name` is the caption beside the mark — §1.5a
rule 2 bars typesetting a name INSTEAD of a mark, and permits naming a mark you are
showing. `group` must be one of the four heads in `groups` below; build/lib/about.js
throws on anything else. `relation` is the building, and is present on four rows only.
WHAT SHIPS: 32 marks — the 34 files minus mitsubishi-electric and geco-mechanical-
electrical, which are equipment and contracting rather than clients (05-ajman §6.3).
The 13 typeset names with no artwork are not rows: the presentation is mark-plus-name,
so a client with no mark has no row. Khazna is one of the 13 and cannot be a row under
any X5 or X11 outcome unless ProArc supplies artwork.
RELATIONS, FOUR ONLY. Shown where they do not restate the client's own name; every
other row is a client-equals-building echo and is suppressed (Screen 04's client-row
rule, reused). Each `relation` must match a record title in projects.json exactly —
the wall names no building the site does not hold.
NOTHING ON THE WALL LINKS. Four of 32 rows have a destination and 28 do not; one name
in eight being a link is a broken affordance that invites the reader to test the rest.
ORDER: the four groups in the order below, alphabetical by name within each. No other
order is available without making a ranking claim the page has no basis for.
`provisional: true` marks a group placement ProArc has not confirmed (X5). The build
prints them every run so the guess stays visible instead of hardening into a fact.
